_note: Interest on a loan for an electric vehicle: an individual, "interest payable on loan taken by him from any financial institution for the purpose of purchase of an electric vehicle" (s.132(1), p.166), "subject to the condition that the loan has been sanctioned … during the period beginning on the 1st April, 2019 and ending on the 31st March, 2023" (s.132(2)), "shall not exceed ₹ 150000" (s.132(3), p.167). The same interest is not deductible under any other provision for the same or any other tax year (s.132(4)) — house-property interest under s.22(1)(b) must leave it out (W-078). rulebook DED-80EEB-001, DED-80EX-001. Old regime only (s.202(2)(a)(xii), p.227). TY 2026-27 only; the 1961 counterpart, s.80EEB, is unread (W-075d). D-139.
